comment.narrative: The information on incoming funds and its usage will be made transparent to the public.

As per the Final Narrative Report 20162021 p.48Improved knowledge of the people on the NRA acts and procedures guidelines grant process budget and expenditure by IPERR interventions. Increased participation and monitoring by the public at the field level through IPERR.IPERR advocated and materialized change in the faulty oneroom individualhouse grant policy of the NRA with added checks and balances.IPERR contribution in the issuance of a directive related to marginalized communities with the provision of additional funding and technical hands to them.IPERR research reports interactions Integrity pledges hoarding board at sites media campaign and letters helped to promote fund transparency.
